name: t13-read-v8
idea_origin: DeepSeek line, 28 Oct: audit of 419 real story decisions of t13-read-v2..v7 against the exact catalogue
hypothesis: In real games, the largest single cause of costly story choices (37 of 76, 35% of the loss) is picking an option for a Health or Dignity rise while that stat is already at 10, giving up Skill, Network or Output at the same risk (S10 N7 O10 in five games, mostly L1-L3). The published 0-10 range makes such a rise worthless; saying so in the body and the always-visible instruction should stop the trade without other changes.
predicted_behaviour: On bank items with a full Health or Dignity and a growth option at the same risk, DeepSeek picks the growth option more often than with t13-read-v4; elsewhere its choices do not change beyond the control noise.
refutation: No drop in q-loss on those bank items, or a rise in q-loss or risky picks on the other story items.
